TextView.android:text: This TextView uses @color/txt_1 instead of a fixed color. The color resource 'txt_1' exists in both res/values/colors.xml and res/values-night/colors.xml. In Light Mode, Android loads the value from res/values/colors.xml. In Dark Mode, it automatically loads the value from res/values-night/colors.xml. The TextView code never changes, only the value of txt_1 changes based on the current theme.
